question:
The percentages of people qualifying for the driving test to get a license in different years are shown in the following graph. Study the graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb6b79174aa15b0963eaa68d888d19b3f88f4905cf879da4fd62941f1e94a688.png] 

In the years 1996 and 1997 together, 45,000 people qualified for the driving test. If in the year 1996, a total of 25,000 people took the driving test, then how many people took the test in the year 1997?
solution:
**Calculation:**

 

Number of people who qualified driving test in 1996 = 60% of 25000

= (60)/(100)times 25000 = 15,000

People qualified the driving test in 1997 = 45000 – 15000 = 30,000

According to the question,

⇒ People qualified the driving test in 1997 = 50% = 30,000

⇒ Total number of people who took the driving test in 1997 = 30000 + 30000 = 60,000

**∴ Total number of people who took part in the driving test in 1997 is 60,000.**
